assay: bulk RNA-seq (TruSeq stranded mRNA, NovaSeq 6000), gastrocnemius muscle (S4.13.p1)

exercise: 60 min acute treadmill run at 16 m/min

sample_inclusion: 64 libraries, 8 per genotype x ZT x exercise cell (4F/4M); one sample excluded for low coverage (group HIF1a-mKO, exercise, ZT3) (S4.14.p1); tissue collected immediately after the 60 min bout (S1.6.p1)
primary_estimand: How HIF1a loss and time of day modify the skeletal muscle transcriptional response to acute exercise: KO vs fl/fl within exercised (and sedentary) mice at ZT3 and ZT15, and ZT15 vs ZT3 within each genotype x exercise state (S1.6.p1-p2, Fig. 5)
planned_contrasts: KO vs fl/fl, exercised, ZT3 (S1.6.p2; paper: 516 DEGs)
KO vs fl/fl, exercised, ZT15 (S1.6.p2; paper: 91 DEGs)
KO vs fl/fl, sedentary, ZT3 and ZT15 (S1.6.p2, Fig. 5D; counts only in figure, 'similar profiles')
ZT15 vs ZT3 within fl/fl sedentary (451), fl/fl exercise (273), KO sedentary (101), KO exercise (191) (S1.6.p1)
KO vs fl/fl overall (724 up / 749 down = 1473) (S1.6.p1, SI Fig. S7A; exact contrast not stated)
repeated_measure_unit: none: one gastrocnemius per animal, independent animals
normalization: DESeq2 size factors; independent filtering on mean of normalized counts (20,224 genes passed) (S4.14.p1)
paper_method: DESeq2 negative binomial GLM, design ~ 0 + group + sex (S4.14.p1)
paper_results: Exercise ZT3 KO vs fl/fl 516, ZT15 91; ZT15 vs ZT3: fl/fl sed 451, fl/fl ex 273, KO sed 101, KO ex 191; KO vs fl/fl overall 724 up / 749 down; GSEA GO: oxidative phosphorylation / respiration positively enriched in KO vs fl/fl after exercise at ZT3 not ZT15; Mpi elevated in KO (Fig. 4G)
not_reported: The paper reports no direct exercise vs sedentary DEG counts.
